messages:
incident-bot: P0 - DETECTED: sudden egress failures from AZ2 to internet (metric spike: 502/timeout) — auto-page to #incidents and oncall.
incident-bot: affected service: redwood-hosted-api, region: eu-west-2 (AZ2), initial detections at 2026-02-12T08:00:00Z
sre_kiran: seeing the same. dashboards show 4-6% error rate on generation API from eu-west-2, latency spikes to 3-4s for happy paths.
net_maria: running quick checks on NATs and route tables. can someone confirm if there was a recent terraform change in eu2? @infra_jess @deploy-bot
infra_jess: I rolled a small route-table patch last night to add explicit 0.0.0.0/0 -> nat-az2 for a new subnet. plan looked fine. no nat replacement.
eng_sam: clients reporting intermittent 502s and TCP resets. traceroutes show traffic from some hosts hitting a private instance that is not a NAT (looks like an old bastion).
sre_kiran: oh. that smells like a route table assoc drift — route pointing to eni of decommissioned instance. pulling route table for affected subnets now.
net_maria: grabbing route tables: `aws ec2 describe-route-tables --filters Name=tag:env,Values=prod Name=availability-zone,Values=eu-west-2b`
net_maria: route table rtb-0a1b2c3d has 0.0.0.0/0 -> eni-0ddecaf (decom instance)
eng_sam: that matches traceroute where TTL stops at that host. that host doesn't SNAT. packets dropped/icmp unreachable -> 502s at LB.
sre_kiran: triage: mark as P0, customers impacted (partial), start mitigation -> replace route target to nat-az2 (nat-0f1e2d3c) and then validate.
infra_jess: I'm on it. running: `aws ec2 replace-route --route-table-id rtb-0a1b2c3d --destination-cidr-block 0.0.0.0/0 --instance-id` (switching to --nat-gateway-id)
infra_jess: wait — replace-route failing: Route already has a target of eni-0ddecaf, API refuses replace with nat because route was created as instance-target. need to delete then create. proceeding.
sre_kiran: heads up: deleting route will briefly blackhole egress for that RTB. do we accept brief outage on these subnets? It's already partially broken, alternatives?
net_maria: these subnets are low-traffic control-plane for some infra tasks; acceptable burn for mitigation. we should coordinate to DNS TTLs and inform support.
cust_ops_ellie: customer ops here — opening ticket templates, will notify customers with template: "We're investigating intermittent networking errors in eu-west-2; mitigation underway" — ETA 15m for fix.
infra_jess: deleting route now -> `aws ec2 delete-route --route-table-id rtb-0a1b2c3d --destination-cidr-block 0.0.0.0/0`
deploy-bot: Deploy log: terraform apply by infra_jess @2026-02-12T00:32Z touched module:networking/route_tables (plan included instance-target route additions).
eng_sam: note for postmortem: Terraform allowed an instance-target route to remain in state after instance decommission. suspect drift handling.
infra_jess: creating route to nat: `aws ec2 create-route --route-table-id rtb-0a1b2c3d --destination-cidr-block 0.0.0.0/0 --nat-gateway-id nat-0f1e2d3c` -> OK
sre_kiran: running quick curl tests from a host in affected subnet: `curl -sv https://api.redwood.example/health` -> 200, latency 120ms.
eng_sam: traceroute now goes via nat-0f1e2d3c, external IP as expected.
net_maria: validating other RTBs in AZ2 for same bad eni reference. scanning: found 2 more with ENI targets referencing removed instance.
infra_jess: patching the other 2 now (delete + create->nat). progress at 2/2.
sre_kiran: monitor dashboards for next 10m. pushing alert suppression for noisy error spike to reduce pager storms.
incident-bot: Alert suppression applied to P0 group for metric: api.502.rate in eu-west-2 for 10m to reduce duplicates.
cust_ops_ellie: customer update: "We mitigated a routing misconfiguration causing intermittent 502s for a subset of eu-west-2 traffic. We're monitoring and will follow up with root cause." sending now.
eng_sam: double-checking LB health checks; a couple of targets flapped during outage — they recovered after egress restored. Not seeing persistent app errors.
net_maria: quick root-cause hypothesis: terraform change introduced instance-target 0.0.0.0/0 in some RTBs; instance decommission later left stale ENIs referenced; routing fell back to stale ENI -> no SNAT -> 502s.
sre_kiran: corrective actions right now: 1) ensure all RTBs in eu-west-2 have nat gateway targets for 0.0.0.0/0 where required; 2) run a drift scan for instance-target routes; 3) add check in CI to prevent instance-target default routes in prod RTBs; 4) schedule postmortem.
infra_jess: noted. I'll add an automated sweep job to detect instance-target 0.0.0.0/0 and raise PRs/alerts.
deploy-bot: rollback option: earlier terraform was applied with instance route step — team agrees to update infra module and run a targeted terraform apply to reconcile.
sre_kiran: handing off to net_maria for on-call monitoring and postmortem ownership. I'm going on short break (backup: eng_sam).
net_maria: taking handoff. will run 1h monitoring, assemble timeline, and create postmortem doc. adding follow-up actions and severity notes.
cust_ops_ellie: following up with customers: we've sent the follow-up message and opened support tickets for affected orgs.
incident-bot: Incident marked RESOLVED at 2026-02-12T08:07:00Z by net_maria (mitigated routes replaced).
net_maria: closing notes: mitigation successful, customer impact limited but visible. postmortem to include terraform drift, better pre-deploy checks, and an alert for any 0.0.0.0/0 route that targets an instance.
sre_kiran: thanks all — great coordination.
infra_jess: will draft PR for module change today.
eng_sam: logging for postmortem: traceroutes, route-table diffs, terraform logs stored in s3://redwood-incident-logs/1768500000/
cust_ops_ellie: bookmark: update status page with root-cause once postmortem done.
net_maria: assigned postmortem owner, ETA doc by EOD. closing thread. :white_check_mark:
